full_page.content:
1945, November 15
The following is a faithful transcription of a photo copy of handwritten messages on Seraphic Mass Asso- ciation Cards by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M.Cap.
November 15th 1945 God bless you - Grandma Panyard With all the years - - past bye. Your joys, your sorrows, pleasures, pains, Just fit you for - - on High. Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
God's blessing for yourself Grandma --- and for all who follow on the great pilgrimage to Great Home awaiting the faithful at the end of the war-fare.
Fr. Solanus, F.M.Cap.
Mrs. George Panyard Sr. November 15, 1945 Happy Birthday and God bless you Mrs. Panyard
Fr. Solanus, . F.M.Cap. by her daughters -- and her Sons
Congratulations Mrs. Panyard. Thank the Good God for keeping us from scandal so long and for keeping us in the faith.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
Originals in possession of: Doris Panyard 3248 Maple Grove Rd. Apt. 37 Muskegon, Mich. 4944 1
